name: Admin Accounting Filters
description: Superuser filters the incomes list client-side: period date range, total amount min/max, kind segmented (Esperado/Líquido), collection segmented ("Cobro": Todos/Sin pagos/Parcial/Pagado, mirroring the row payment badge; its "Sin pagos" value also backs the builtin "Solo esperados" landing tab, next to the seeded "Todos los esperados"), partner segmented (Gustavo/Carlos/ProjectApp), ledger segmented (Todas/Empresa/Personal Gustavo/Personal Carlos), free-text search with debounce, active-filter count badge and reset. Powered by useAccountingFilters + AccountingFilterPanel. The revamped panel adds live-updating range dropdowns (debounced input), removable applied-filter chips, a filtered results counter and <mark> highlighting of search occurrences in the table. Saved tabs carry a base_filters restore point (all five panel views): filter edits under a tab still auto-save, but a drifted tab shows a '•' dot and its context menu offers 'Restaurar filtros' (back to the seeded/created definition) and 'Fijar como base' (re-baseline), so a seeded tab can always recover its meaning (the builtin tabs need none: they never drift). The strip is also reorderable: a chip is dragged to its place (hold to start on touch, so the strip can still be swiped), or moved from its own ⋯ menu ('Mover a la izquierda'/'Mover a la derecha') and with Ctrl/Cmd+arrows on the focused chip, which is the path for anyone who cannot drag. Dragging never applies the filter it moved. The order is per (user, view) and covers the factory presets too — a builtin's order rides a placeholder row matched by builtin_key, while its filters stay in the frontend — with 'Todas' pinned first because it sits outside the sortable list. 'Restablecer' in Configuración returns the whole strip to the factory order without touching the tabs the user saved.
